figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of the FPED framework. Stage 1 establishes a mapping from multinetwork fMRI signals to CLIP embedding space. Stage 2 incorporates spatiotemporal routing mechanisms to enable dynamic gating of features across temporal brain activity variations.
Fig. 3. Semantic heatmaps of brain-network-based experts. Each row displays the original image alongside heatmaps from seven experts (V, SM, DA, VA, L, C, DM).
Fig. 4. Comparison of MoE routing weights across modalities.
